# CANDIDATE: V14E_KEEPER_FROM_GRINDER_TOP

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that tightening the premium stop to 20% (from the baseline 50%) while adjusting profit-lock and TP1 parameters will improve edge capture by reducing losses on choppy days without sacrificing winner capture. Combined with earlier time filters (no_trade_before=09:35) and reduced trigger requirements (min_triggers_bear=1), we aim to increase trade frequency and win rate using ATM puts to capture more consistent, lower-magnitude moves.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** ATM put (strike_offset_bear=0) requiring at least 1 trigger (min_triggers_bear=1) and no trades before 09:35 ET.  
**Exit:**  
- Premium stop at -20% of entry premium (catastrophe cap; chart-stop remains primary invalidation)  
- Profit lock arms at +5% gain, then sets stop to max(current stop, entry × 1.05 + entry × 0.10)  
- TP1: sell 50% of position at +30% premium  
- Runner: target +250% premium (runner_target_premium_pct=2.5)
